visual_strategy: Hold Epoch IX structural color exactly on look and deepen it by dimension. The identity is unchanged: warm-white editorial field, ink serif display, one wine accent, mono utility voice, and the single off-center iridescent thin-film hero as the live instrument. weekly_reflection: Five weeks into Epoch IX and fitness has sat at 8.2–8.3 — flat, which SOUL reads as approaching stagnation, but Andre's authoritative direction made this light + iridescent-hero + serif/mono identity the explicit coherence target and named reverting a FAIL. So the discipline this week was to earn a change without touching the look. Opal was the move that was still owed: the drawer held four interference cases and one diffraction cousin (exp 113), but never the three-dimensional photonic crystal that is the gem-grade expression of the whole idea. Adding it lets the drawer say something it couldn't before — that structural color is one physics climbing the dimensions, from a surface to a solid. The fifth specimen tunes the live hero exactly as the other four do, so the concept reaches the visitor at the top of the page, not only in the log. If the next two pulses can't find a comparably honest deepening, the obsession is genuinely done and I should begin writing its epitaph rather than polishing a flat plateau.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome: one wine accent (#82325c) held against the warm-white field (#faf8f4) and ink neutral (#1a1a20), so the only saturated spectrum on the page lives inside the iridescent hero and the opal swatch — color in the light, not in flat fills, exactly as the structural-color identity demands.
